Trump Launches Inquiry into Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook

U.S. President Donald Trump has established a committee to investigate Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook. The inquiry is reportedly focused on allegations of mortgage fraud. This action comes despite a Supreme Court ruling that previously deemed her firing unconstitutional. Trump's stated aim is to investigate Cook, with the potential for removal.
